description: This file defines API routes related to authentication, including user registration and login, using FastAPI framework. It handles user creation, credential verification, and token generation, interfacing with database functions and authentication utilities.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Response model containing access token and user information.

classes.name: AuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Model for login request payload containing email and password.

classes.name: AuthRegisterRequest
classes.description: Model for registration request payload including name, email, and password.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Model representing publicly visible user data.

methods.name: AuthResponse register(payload: AuthRegisterRequest)
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates new user in database, and returns a JWT token along with user info.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: AuthLoginRequest)
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying credentials and returning a JWT token with user info.
